root_cause.text: The RDS/IB (InfiniBand) transport code was not network namespace aware and relied on global state without proper per-namespace isolation, allowing it to be used in non-initial network namespaces where it would function incorrectly.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds namespace checks in `rds_set_transport()` (`af_rds.c`) and `rds_ib_laddr_check()` (`ib.c`) to restrict RDS/IB to the initial network namespace by returning `-EPROTOTYPE` when the current net is not `init_net` and the transport is not TCP. This directly prevents the use of RDS/IB in non-initial namespaces, addressing the fact that the existing code “will not work properly” in such contexts.
